t: Specially formulated blend of lubricants, extreme pressure additives and supplementary components designed to improve the performance and extend the life of cutting and drilling equipment. Lubricates to reduce tip welding and improves machine finishes. Prevents pitting and metal seizures, eases mechanical processing of metals and reduces heat and damage caused by friction. Provides an exceptional finish, as well as protecting and prolonging the life of equipment. Flip straw down for spray or up for a precise, narrow spray. 360° valve allows upright or upside-down application.
b: Designed for Use on Stainless Steel & Titanium Components
